journey.name: ED-07 A failed edit-mode load replaces the form and retries
journey.description:
Covers FR-09 inside the editor - the second of its three failure fields (REQUIREMENTS.md section 9, lines 243-248). Edit mode opens by fetching the task; if that fetch fails there is no form to protect, so the failure becomes the screen, with Retry.
Note that the app bar stays in all three branches (TaskEditorScreen.kt:113-130), so Back and a disabled Save remain on screen over the error. That is intentional: a user must always be able to leave.
Retry is tapped rather than merely observed: onRetry re-reads taskId from the state and calls load() again, and the form it seeds on the second attempt is the only proof that the recovery path reaches the source rather than just clearing the error. The source is mended between the two attempts, which is what makes the retry succeed rather than repeat.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 # wait for the list, then break the source before opening a row adb shell am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 1.0

actions.action: Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is on screen
Verify that a "Retry" button is on screen
Verify that no "Title" field is on screen
Verify that an element with the content description "Back" is on screen
Using adb, mend the source with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 0.0`
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is no longer on screen
Verify that "Retry" is no longer on screen
Verify that the "Title" field is now on screen and contains "Renew domain registration"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field contains "Expires end of month"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is selected
Tap the element with the content description "Back"
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen with its four rows still listed
